goal: Lock Xoah dual-convergence reading against Dune comparison
body: Shard-backed canon correction from Dave: Xoah-Lin Oda's Haitian-Japanese heritage is not generic mixed ancestry. Her body is the convergence of two historically engineered rare-blood zones: the Japanese line through Honnōji Temple and the Haitian line through the Haitian Revolution. Relevant archive anchors: shard:17301@db9 LOUVERTURE_CORBIN_PARALLEL.md ('Atlantic Half of the Double Helix'), shard:17308@db9 PROTOCOL_SEEDLINE.md ('12,000-Year Genetic Algorithm'), shard:16863@db8 / shard:16895@db7 Japan Isolation & Xoah's Dual Bloodline Significance, shard:16965@db7 Xoah dossier, shard:22493@db1 Elara Toussaint/Yasuke/Honnōji lineage hinge. Preserve this as the primary Dune resonance: rare opposing convergence bloodlines fused into one designed descendant, not simply 'hero and villain blood mixed.'
